reviews.title: App is getting worse and worse
reviews.text:
Suggest avoiding this application like three-day old chicken. It is a prime example of the term “ensh*tification” - with every update, the app performs worse, has more ads, less live sport and costs more.

Notably:
- there are now ads that play whenever you start a stream, so when a game is on you always miss 10 seconds.
- when you pause, you get a full-screen ad, so when you want to pause to look at something, or scrub through the timeline, you can’t actually see what you want to.
- the picture-in-picture has been broken for months; the audio doesn’t switch between streams when using HomePods as an audio output.


It’s honestly a horrible experience, and I’d suggest any alternative at this stage - it’s getting worse and more expensive.

reviews.title: Poor Customer Service and Serious Privacy Concerns
reviews.text:
I subscribed to Kayo Sports, but due to an issue with my mobile number, I was unexpectedly logged into another person’s account. This raised serious concerns about the security and privacy of customer information.

When I tried to resolve the issue and cancel my subscription, I experienced extremely frustrating customer service. Despite multiple attempts, I struggled to access my own account and manage my subscription, while payments continued to be deducted.

It is unacceptable for a paid subscription service to have such account access issues, especially when customers’ personal information may be at risk.

Kayo seriously needs to improve its account security, customer support, and subscription cancellation process. Very disappointing experience, and I would not recommend this service.

reviews.title: Disgusting streaming service
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 — Paying premium prices for a service I couldn’t even use

Absolutely disgraceful experience with Kayo.

I’m paying around $40 a month for a sports streaming service, yet when I actually wanted to watch the game I was locked out by their ridiculous account verification system.

Kayo demanded that I verify my account. I completed the verification on my phone and was literally told the verification was complete — yet every time I tried to watch the game, I was thrown straight back into the same verification process again.

Even worse, the verification emails I was supposed to receive simply weren’t arriving. I changed my password successfully, checked my email repeatedly and followed the process, but still couldn’t access the service I PAY FOR.

What exactly am I paying for?

People subscribe to live sports services because they want to watch LIVE SPORT. Missing part of a game because your streaming provider cannot get its own account verification system working completely defeats the purpose of the subscription.

For the amount Kayo charges every month, customers should not have to waste their time troubleshooting broken verification loops just to access something they have already paid for.

The most frustrating part is that my subscription and payment apparently work perfectly fine when it comes to taking my money — it’s accessing the actual service that becomes the problem.

This isn’t a minor inconvenience. If a paying customer cannot reliably access a live sporting

reviews.title: Limited remote area access
reviews.text:
Currently travelling in my caravan I was surprised to learn that Kayo coverage is not available in certain postcodes. Why? I reached out to Kayo via their website but couldn’t get past their bot that had all the standard (and yet totally meaningless) answers. These answers include travelling to a supported location or taking on a Foxtel sports pack subscription. Since I was trying to watch a live AFL match moving to a supported location would take longer than the match. I certainly aren’t going to take on an extra subscription for something I should already have access to. As a paid up subscriber the service should available regardless of my, or anyone else’s, location. Very disappointing money grab.

It is not user friendly, always glitches and freezes and I can never fast forward in replays- I have a new tv and watch sport at non peak times and excellent wifi therefore has no reason to be so bad. I pay $40 a month the worst platform that is nothing but unreliable. Every other streaming platform is way better than this and I never have the same problems. Did I mention how awful the quality is? Did I mention how when I press play it takes me back5 mins or sometimes spoils a race? Well, this is the tip of the iceberg of the problems I experience. I wish there was another reliable platform who was also more affordable because this is outrageous. The platform is so bad it makes me not want to watch sport again. Maybe invest the excessive subscription fees into fixing this god awful platform so we can enjoy sport again. 
Thanks for disappointing me AGAIN!

reviews.title: PiP background play broken in 2026
reviews.text: Kayo’s picture in picture is now pausing after 30 seconds of being swiped into the background. This never happened in previous years, noticed it in 2026 AFL season. Please revert back to old setting, sometimes I just need the video to be on the background while I use other apps in full screen. I still want to hear the audio, so keep playing the stream in the background please and fix this. I’m considering deleting my subscription because this update to the app in 2026 is awful. Seeking for rewinding or fast forwarding doesn’t show the same timestamp as the live feed instead it shows the countdown rather than elapsed time. I beloved this was done to make it trickier for people who watch footy on a delay to fact forward through ads. 2025 version of the app had better timestamp setup. Go back to 2025 please.

reviews.title: Bold strategy revealed
reviews.text: Wow what an incredible boss move. Upgrade the app with fewer features and a truly awful navigation and menu. Sports you want to watch shown with generic looking images and text. buried under bright cards displaying spoilers and clips that I’m not interested in I’ve given you my favourite sports by clicking your little favourites icons not really sure what difference it makes.  Removed the ability to slow or double speed the stream. Now I can’t catch up to live when I haves delayed start.  Gone is the ability to adjust the quality. Whatever happened to giving us what we want? Now its give us what we don’t want and bump the price what’s next an infinite 2FA loop. Unskippable ads launching soon, mini box the action to play ads on the lower tier. I can’t even…

reviews.title: Classic Kayo
reviews.text: This app is pretty much exactly what you’d expect from Kayo: absolute garbage. Despite what smiling current and former players say in their glossy ads, “Don’t Get On Board” unless absolutely necessary. If it can go wrong, it will. I’ve tried it on a varied range of Apple devices and you can reliably expect it to freeze, randomly close, skip backwards or ahead, rotate the screen, move in and out of HD, play the sound out of sync and more. Doesn’t seem to matter if you have a 100 mbps wired ethernet connection or if you use telstra data - the same glitches consistently happen. Don’t even think about trying to connect an external monitor! The home screen is a flashing mess with no design similarity to the website or TV app. Is it like this just so you’re bamboozled and stay using it for longer? It’s like they take my watching history and intentionally suggest me the opposite sports and programs just to annoy. This is a disaster of their monopoly that seems to be intentionally ruining ‘the big match’. PS: When can I opt out of gambling ads, like on SBS, Kayo?

reviews.title: Poor customer service and impossible to cancel subscription
reviews.text:
After having no knowledge that I had a running subscription. I reached out to kayo through email to resolve the issue. 

I felt employees made it specifically harder to cancel my subscription. As it took many months and a long email chain with poor communication from multiple people. Employees said we couldn’t cancel our subscription because of an email issue and when we resolved it, they said it still couldn’t be canceled in a very confusing and poorly written email. This is unacceptable and poor behaviour. Eventually through more assertive emails we were able to cancel the subscription. We only got refunded for one month and employees called this a ‘goodwill gesture’ even though we specifically requested at least two months as we had no idea the account was even active and we were trying to cancel for longer than 2 months. This is a very large company and refunding a family for 2 months would have cost nothing. This has been a very disappointing experience to say the least. 

And the last thing to say is, every program run under Hubble is horrible, the prices are high and the app quality is very low. Constant glitching and many bugs. I have also had a binge subscription and it was equally as bad, plus they never email you so I didn’t even know I had a subscription running. Not to mention constant ads (which all seem to be political…)
